Callais; the House votes in an open primary on Nov 3 (a majority wins the seat) with a Dec 12 runoff); MO CD119 (2025 map (in the Census CD120 file) stayed by the U.S. Supreme Court on 2026-09-25; the 2022 map stays in force for 2026); NC CD120 (Legislature enacted S.L. 2025-95 (2025-10-22)); OH CD120 (Ohio Redistricting Commission adopted a new map 2025-10-31); TN CD120 (Legislature enacted HB 7003 / SB 7004 (passed 2026-05-07, signed 2026-06-03)); TX CD120 (Legislature enacted plan PLANC2333 (2025-08-29); a district court injunction was stayed by the U.S. Supreme Court 2025-12-04); UT CD120 (Court-adopted Map 1 (Third District Court, 2025-11-10) under the Proposition 4 litigation); every other state on its 119th Congress map. A district lists the county subdivisions (strong-MCD states only) and places (incorporated places and Census Designated Places) with at least 50 2020 residents inside it (or half the residents of a smaller place), largest first, named as in the Census Bureau's 2025 Gazetteer files.
